In a proportional-odds cumulative-logit ordinal regression of COVID-19 severity on BCG vaccination (TRTGRP; ref=Placebo), prior medical history (any of the 18 baseline MEDICAL HISTORY checklist conditions present; ref=none), their interaction, and the patient-interaction-frequency control (patients_seen; ref=1-50), the **interaction odds ratio is OR = 1.26 (95% CI 0.65–2.42, p = 0.49)** on all 1,000 participants.

Interpretation: prior medical history is associated with a slightly larger shift toward more-severe COVID-19 among BCG-vaccinated participants than among placebo participants (est. +26% in the comorbidity-by-severity OR), but this is **not statistically significant** and the wide confidence interval includes 1 — i.e., there is **no evidence of an interaction** between BCG status and prior medical history on COVID-19 severity once patient interaction frequency is controlled.

Specification actually fitted (severity direction: higher = worse; 0 = no COVID-19 AE; severity = subject peak of per-record max(AEWK1HS–AEWK12HS), 0–7, with 4 subjects' missing AEWK filled from AEHS/OnsetHS):
- Severity 0–7: patients_seen 51-100 OR=1.72 (p=0.012), >100 OR=2.31 (p=0.031) [control: interaction frequency is clearly associated with severity]; BCG main OR=0.99 (p=0.98); prior-MH main OR=1.74 (p=0.021); **BCG×prior-MH OR=1.2569 (95% CI 0.6533–2.4181, p=0.4934)**.

Sign convention verified numerically: an independent manual proportional-odds MLE reproduces the statsmodels coefficients (max |Δ|=0.00013), and positive coefficients correspond to higher severity (mean peak severity higher in the MH-present groups: Placebo 0.236→0.440; BCG 0.246→0.528).

Sensitivities (all non-significant, confirming robustness):
- Collapsing sparse top categories (4/5/6 levels): OR = 1.257 / 1.256 / 1.258.
- AESEV-based 0–4 outcome, complete-case (n=957): OR=1.17 (p=0.68); with missing-AESEV imputed (n=1000): OR=1.19 (p=0.60).
- Prior-MH as cardiometabolic subset: OR=0.52 (p=0.07, borderline, opposite direction); as condition count: OR=1.05 (p=0.74).
- Controls: +expect_interact OR=1.30 (p=0.44); numeric patients_seen OR=1.25 (p=0.51); +Age+SEX OR=1.21 (p=0.57).

Data-quality notes handled: MHORRES coding verified as 1=No/2=Yes; entire MH file is baseline (all Screening-Day -3 to 1); 143 all-NaN AE placeholder rows = subjects with no AEs (severity 0); COVID events identified by AEPT (COVID-19 / COVID-19 pneumonia / Asymptomatic COVID-19); AESPID non-uniqueness does not affect AEPT-based detection.
